hero.title: Know the way is clear before you go
hero.sub: With parents, kids, a wheelchair or friends from abroad: we check the way from parking to restrooms at Donghae sights and plan your day.
hero.cta: Plan my day in a minute
hero.say: Hi! I'm Dongi, your Donghae travel buddy. Who are you traveling with today?
mode.label: Rate places for
plan.greet: Nice to meet you! Answer four quick questions and I'll plan your route.
q.move: Does anyone need an easier way around? I'll only pick places you can reach. Nothing is stored.
q.style: What do you enjoy? Pick any.
q.last: Last one: how long, and where do you start?
plan.done: I planned {n} stops. Take a look!
result.allOk: Every stop is easy to get around
result.caution: {n} stop(s) need care · tap a card for details
safety.say: These are open now. Please call before you go.
report.say: Something blocked at {p}? One photo is enough.
report.thanks: Thank you! The next traveler will have an easier time.
share.title: Share
share.say: The link opens the same route. Your choices live only in the link.
error.server: Connection is slow. Showing a basic route first.
